# Pedro Tabacof

<p class="role">Principal Machine Learning Scientist at Fin · Ireland</p>

At Fin, I lead Fin Core, a 12+ person workstream that defines how the AI agent answers questions, follows guidance, takes actions, and handles the conversation around them.

In more than ten years, my models have informed a $10M annual marketing budget at a mobile gaming company, credit decisions involving tens of millions of dollars in exposure at Nubank, and fraud screening for more than two-thirds of iFood transactions. My research includes an ICLR main-conference paper and four NeurIPS workshop papers, with [600+ citations](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=mbEp-w0AAAAJ&hl=en).

<p class="profile-links"><a href="mailto:tabacof@gmail.com">Email</a> · <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/tabacof/">LinkedIn</a> · <a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=mbEp-w0AAAAJ&hl=en">Google Scholar</a> · <a href="https://github.com/tabacof/">GitHub</a></p>
